e: 她現在有來自全世界的粉絲。描述努力後成功的結果，與前句語意連貫。

s: Mom: Who’s coming to dinner tonight（今晚）?  Sue:
o: I made a video last night.
We’re giving a concert in May.
I work at the desk every day.
e: 媽媽問誰會來吃晚餐？Sue　回答「我的朋友　Dakota　要來」，語意清楚且自然。

s: Yuki enjoys singing, but she hates 　　　.
e: 她討厭在別人面前唱歌。描述對一件事情既喜歡又討厭某一面，符合語意反差。

s: It is difficult 　　　.
o: for Yuki to sing on stage
e: Yuki　上臺唱歌很困難。語法結構為　It is＋adj.＋for　人＋to V，正確且語意連貫。

s: Cathy is really sorry 　　　.
o: for being late for work again
she is good at making yummy chicken sandwiches
she is so popular with her friends
e: 因為上班又遲到了她覺得很抱歉。be sorry for + V-ing　為常見句型，語法及語意都正確。

s: Jamie: Did you feed our dog Lucky today?  Kim: Oh no, 　　　.
e: remember to V… 記得去做；remember V-ing… 記得做過。Kim　被提醒才發現自己沒有記得餵狗，這句話語意是「我沒有記得自己有餵牠」表示可能沒餵。

s: Yesterday afternoon, I looked here and there in my bedroom for my watch, 　　　.
o: and I found them under the bed
but I just couldn’t find it
but it was on the bed
e: 在臥室到處尋找手錶，「但是就是無法找得到」。選項(Ａ)　them　須改成　it。

s: Liz: What do you want to be in the future?  Ken:
o: I don’t plan to be a police officer.
I want to be a writer.
I hate to cook, but I enjoy eating yummy food.
I love singing.  How about you?
e: Liz　詢問　Ken　將來想當什麼，Ken　回答一項職業名稱。

s: Sam wants to be a cook 　　　.
o: , but his singing is not good enough
because he is good at cooking
e: Sam　想當廚師，「因為他很會烹飪」。

s: Alex: What does Rick want to be in the future?  Mark:
o: Yes, he wants to be a writer.
He is a great baseball player.
He plans to be a doctor.
No, he doesn’t plan to be a mail carrier.
e: Alex　詢問　Mark　未來想當什麼，所以　Mark　要回答一項職業名稱，而且　Wh-　問句不需用　Yes　或　No　開頭回答。

s: Carol: We plan to go to the movies tonight（今晚）.  Do you want to come?  Nancy: No, 　　　.
o: I need to finish doing my math homework
I want to be a writer
I love to go to the movies
e: Nancy　回答　No，表示不去看電影，所以推測　Nancy　回答「要做完數學功課」。

s: Emi: 　　　  Leo: I practice it every day.
o: What do you plan to do this evening?
Do you want to be a writer?
Why are you good at playing the guitar?
How many hours do you practice playing the guitar a day?
e: Leo　回答每天都會練習，所以推測　Emi　問「你為何很會彈吉他呢？」。

s: Mike: What do you want to be in the future?  Sara: I’m not sure.  Mike: 　　　  You can interview me in the future.
o: You have a farm.  You can grow lots of apples.
Why don’t you want to be a fisherman?  Don’t you enjoy catching fish?
e: Mike　要　Sara「能當記者。」將來她就可以採訪他。

s: After many years of hard work, 　　　.
o: he did not like his future job
he loved keeping his house clean
he could keep working for 365 days at a time
e: 在很多年的努力工作之後，「他成為一個有名氣的歌手」。

s: Tina: Do you want to go to Ximending with us this afternoon?  Mary:
o: Sure.  Let’s meet in front of our school at 2:00 p.m.
Yes, we had a lot of time.
I love to go shopping.  How about you?
e: Tina　約　Mary　今天下午去西門町，所以推測　Mary　和　Tina　約地點碰面。

s: I enjoy teaching young kids, so 　　　.
o: my stories are not good enough
my future job is to be a reporter
I want to be a teacher
e: 我喜愛教導年幼的孩童，所以「我想要當老師」。

s: Jay: What do you plan to do after school?  Ken:
o: I want to play the guitar.
e: Jay　問「放學後打算做什麼？」，所以　Ken　回答「我想要彈吉他。」。

s: Jeff likes toys（玩具）.  He plans 　　　.
o: send different toys to kids all over the world
made lots of toys for poor kids
to work in a toy factory and make toys
e: plan(s)＋to V...，即「Jeff　喜歡玩具。他計畫在一玩具工廠工作並製作玩具」。

s: Jane: Your brother plays baseball well（好）.  Is he on the school team?  Rick:
o: No, he doesn’t practice playing it.
Yes, he likes to play basketball.
Yes, he is poor at playing baseball.
No, but he enjoys playing it very much.
e: 回答　Yes，表示參加校隊；回答　No，表示沒有。

s: Cathy is really sorry 　　　.
o: for being late for work again
she is good at making yummy chicken sandwiches
she is so popular with her friends
e: be sorry for＋V-ing...；sorry　之後也可接「(that)＋主詞＋動詞...」，但選項(Ｃ)(Ｄ)語意不合。

s: Amy: What do you enjoy doing in your free time?  Beth:
o: Yes, I enjoy watching ball games.
I like to watch movies on TV.
No, I need to mop the floor.
e: Amy　詢問　Beth　空閒時喜歡做什麼？Beth　以「喜歡看電視上的電影。」回應。

s: Jenny, your math is not good enough.  You need 　　　.
e: Jenny，妳的數學不夠好，妳需要「持續練習」。人＋need＋to V...。

s: Hank loves to be with young kids, so 　　　.
o: he wants to be a teacher
he plans to be a great singer like Jay Chou
he enjoys reading story books very much
e: Hank　喜愛和年幼的孩童在一起，所以「他想要當老師」。

s: Greg: What do you want to be in the future?  Grace:
o: You can also be a great farmer.
I plan to interview the popular writer later.
A good doctor like my father.
What about you?  Do you want to be a basketball player?
e: Greg　詢問　Grace「未來想當什麼？」，Grace　以「（想當個）像我爸爸一樣的好醫生。」回應。

s: Mark: I want to join the baseball team, but I am poor at playing baseball.  Pete:
o: Yeah, I’m really good at playing sports.
Don’t be worried.  You just need to keep practicing, practicing, and practicing.
Why not?  You can play baseball with me.
What about me?  Can I play it with you?
e: Mark　想加入棒球隊，但他認為他拙於打棒球。Pete　要他「不要擔心。只要持續練習、練習、再練習。」。

s: Jim: I want to play in the basketball game, but I don’t play basketball well（好）enough.  Ted:
o: Just keep practicing, and you can get your success one day.
Wow.  You are good at playing basketball.
What about me?  I want to join the baseball team, too.
That’s nice.  You can study very often.
e: Jim　想在籃球比賽中上場，但是他籃球打得不夠好。Ted　要他「就只要持續練習，而總有一天你就能成功的。」。

s: My mom is a busy factory worker, but she 　　　.
o: tries to make new and yummy food for my family
hates to make her new dishes with others
seldom thinks about making new dishes in the kitchen
e: 我媽媽是個忙碌的工廠作業員，但是她「設法為我的家人做出新的美味食物」。

s: Liz: Do you want to have some cookies?  Ken: No, thanks.
e: Liz　問要不要吃餅乾，Ken　說不用了，謝謝，並以「我的胃／肚子很痛。」回應。

s: Mom: Why are you still doing your homework?  It’s 11:30 p.m.  Amy: But I have a lot of homework.  Mom: Can’t you do it tomorrow（明天）?  Tomorrow is Saturday.  　　　  Amy: OK, Mom.
o: Why don’t you get up late?
Getting enough sleep is important for you.
You need to go to school early, right?
Come on.  Let me take you home.
e: 媽媽要　Amy　早點去睡，功課可以明天星期六做，畢竟「得到足夠的睡眠很重要。」。

s: It’s special for me 　　　.  Everyone was singing and dancing in their room that night.
o: to have a music party on YouTube
to go home on rainy days
to go to a family doctor
e: 「在　YouTube　開一個音樂派對」對我而言很特別。大家在他們的房間唱歌跳舞一整夜。

s: is good for your health.
o: Doing some exercise in the morning
e: 「早上做些運動」對健康不錯。

s: Mom: Emi, it’s 11:40 p.m.  Why do you keep sitting at the desk?  　　　  Emi: I want to go to bed early, but I need to study for many tests（考試）at school tomorrow（明天）.  Mom: My poor girl.  Don’t worry about the tests.  Just go to bed now.
o: It’s not bad to study so late.
Are you playing with something special?
Isn’t it bad for your health to go to bed so late?
Getting up early is important for students.
e: 媽媽認為「太晚就寢不是對健康不好嗎？」，她要　Emi　不要擔心明天的考試，就去睡覺了吧。

s: Mom: Greg, don’t go to bed so late.  It’s not good for your health.  Greg: But I can’t help it.  There’s always so much homework to do.  Mom: 　　　  Greg: All right.  I decide to go to bed before 12:00 a.m. from now on（從現在起）.
o: Drinking enough water does you good.
It’s important for junior high school students to get enough sleep.
You need to give it a try.
You need to eat healthy food.
e: 媽媽要　Greg　不要這麼晚才睡覺。Greg　知道要這樣，但他沒有辦法。媽媽又告訴　Greg「國中生睡眠充足是很重要的。」，Greg　勉強同意並決定從現在起凌晨　12：00　之前會上床睡覺。

o: I want to catch a ball.
My dream is to grow healthy fruit on a farm.
When I grow up, I want to have a dream.
I want to do it again in the future.
e: Alex　以「夢想是在農園種有益健康的水果。」回答出　Jill　所問的「長大時，想做什麼？」。

s: Jack: Wow.  You are good at singing.  By the way, can you sing at my birthday party this Saturday evening?  Lulu: I don’t think that’s a good idea.
o: I need to look at your teeth.
I get butterflies in my stomach when singing in front of people.
Let me plan the night for you and me.
Do I need to?  I’m terrible at dancing, you know.
e: Lulu　不認為在　Jack　的生日派對唱歌是好主意。「她在人們面前唱歌會感到緊張。」。

s: Tina: My dream is to be a successful dancer in the future, but I’m poor at dancing.  And...  Ella: Don’t worry.  　　　  You are sure to become one.
o: Why don’t you just give up?
It’s not special to be a dancer.
Just keep practicing dancing long hours every day.
You can put a big wig on and dance in front of people.
e: Tina　跳舞不太好，但她夢想當個成功的舞者。Ella　鼓勵她「就持續每天好幾小時練習跳舞。」一定會夢想成真的。

s: Hank: It’s great to be a YouTuber like Cai Aga.  Mom, can I be one when I grow up?  Mom: I don’t even hear of him or know anything about a YouTuber.  What does one need to do?  Hank:
o: Make videos for his YouTube channel.
Sell things between many places all over Taiwan.
e: YouTuber（影片創作者）需要「為　YouTube　頻道製作影片。」。

s: I don’t like to see people when I sing for them.  Maybe 　　　.
o: it’s my dream job to be a singer
I can put on a big wig, and then I can’t see them at all
I can make fun of their faces
e: 說話者唱歌時，不喜歡面對人群，自我解嘲「或許能戴上一頂假髮，那麼根本就看不到他們了」。

s: A famous YouTuber like Cai Aga 　　　.
o: likes to fighting for people’s rights
enjoys to plan a day for his YouTube channel
needs to make videos for his YouTube channel
hates to have a dream of his own
e: 像蔡阿嘎有名氣的影片創作者「必須為他的　YouTube　頻道製作影片」。

s: This is my first time to sing in front of so many people.
o: May I give it a try?
How come I keep getting butterflies in my stomach?
It’s my last time to give it up.
Was I doing a good job when I was singing on stage?
e: 這是我第一次在這麼多人面前唱歌。「我怎麼一直感到緊張呢？」。

s: Greg: I plan to 　　　.  Yuki: Good for you.
o: make fun of the new student
put on a heavy jacket on a hot summer day
help people all over the world when they are in need
give up my plan for the future
e: Greg　規畫「當世界各地的人有所需求時要幫助他們」，Yuki　才會以「你真棒。」回應。

s: The famous lawyer 　　　.  Do you need him for your case（案例）?
o: seldom helps poor people in need
loves making videos for his YouTube channel
is good at fighting for people’s rights
e: 那個名律師「很會為人們的權利而戰」。你需要他來處理你的案例嗎？

s: One of the girl’s teeth hurts a lot, but 　　　.
o: she plans to see the dentist later
she never brushes them before going to bed
she needs to brush them twice a day
e: 女孩一顆牙齒痛得很厲害，但是「她討厭看牙醫」。

s: The baby likes listening to music.  When the music is playing, 　　　.
o: he tries to turn it off
e: 那嬰兒喜歡聽音樂。當音樂在播放時，「他不哭了」。(Ｂ)停下來開始哭(Ｄ)嬰兒不會嘗試關掉音樂。

s: Ann’s friends kept calling her, so 　　　.
o: it was fun for her to interview them
she did not finish reading the book
she was sorry for talking about them
she thanked them for getting some exercise
e: Ann　的朋友一直打電話給她，所以「她沒看完那本書」。

s: Zoey: Don’t you remember 　　　?  When do you plan to give it back to me?  Pete: What?!  You lent so much money to me?  How could it be?
o: lending so much money to me
e: remember＋V-ing...：記得做過　V...　的動作（做過了）；remember＋to V...：記得要去做　V...　的動作（還沒做）。由語意是「Pete　向　Zoey　借過錢」，故選(Ｃ)。

p:
克漏字測驗
　　Rene liked dogs and cats when he was a little boy. 　(1)　 He often reads books about animals and looks for information on the Internet.
　　However, taking good care of pets is not an easy job. At first, he didn’t know how to do it well. For example, he saw one important thing: 　(2)　. Some dogs even got sick easily. He became very worried and tired.
　　Sometimes he wanted to stop doing this. But his family always told him, “Successful people never stop trying.” So, he told himself that 　(3)　. He started asking animal doctors for help and learned a lot from them.
　　After years of hard work, he is now a great animal doctor. He often makes YouTube videos to tell people his ideas about keeping pets. At the end of his videos, he always says, “　(4)　 Just do your best!”
o: So, he plans to become an animal doctor to help them.
However, he enjoys making fun of sick animals in his free time.
Because he hates cleaning the house and feeding the pets.
So, taking food to different factories is his dream job.
e: 前文提到　Rene　從小就愛貓狗，後文說他常上網找動物的資訊，可推知他想幫助動物。
k: 克漏字—文意題組：理解文章(圖、表)並推論。

p:
Direidyth was a very quiet girl. She didn’t like talking to other people. However, she had a big dream. She wanted to be a famous reporter in the future.
　　At first, she always got butterflies in her stomach when she stood in front of people. She was worried about it, so she asked her teacher for help. Her teacher gave her some words from a book: “　(1)　 But dreams can come true when you know what you want and never give up.”
　　Direidyth decided to make a change. Because she knew that 　(2)　, she started to read lots of news and practiced speaking. She was very busy learning new things and slept only five hours a day. But she never minded. She just kept 　(3)　.
　　After a year of hard work, she finally won a prize in a news report contest! She became much better at her job. Now, 　(4)　. She always says, “I want to help people in need and fight for their rights!”
o: Making a lot of money is bad for health.
Eating nothing every morning is a terrible idea.
Taking food to different stores takes much time.
e: 後方提到「但只要你有目標並永不放棄，夢想就能成真」，推知(Ａ)「要成功並不容易」符合老師鼓勵她的情境。
